# Chrona Scheduler

> A drag-and-drop scheduler for any Dataverse table with a start and an end. It installs as one managed solution and runs inside model-driven apps. No Chrona account is needed to use it; Auto Schedule, which fills and balances the schedule, connects to the Chrona service.

Every page below is plain Markdown. Read them in order for an install; each stands alone for a question.

## Install

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/README.md): what it is, why builders pick it, the ten-minute setup, what you get, Auto Schedule, staff rostering, performance, trust.
- [Install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/docs/install.md): import the solution, give people roles, bind the scheduler to a view, open it in an app, connect for Auto Schedule.
- [Bindings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/docs/bindings.md): every binding in the property pane, the three that matter, and what the rest are for.
- [Layouts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/docs/layouts.md): the four layouts (timeline, roster grid, top-down, agenda), when each fits, and the view row setting that picks one.
- [Where things are set up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/docs/configure.md): the property pane, the calendar and view configuration rows with every setting, the toolbar's per-user choices, the Workforce tables, sites, agreements and the roster import from Excel.
- [Questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/docs/faq.md): what the platform shows along the way, removing the solution, languages, what Auto Schedule sends.

## Chrona Workforce Mobile

- [Directory setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/docs/workforce-mobile-directory.md): select worker groups, keep worker details and reporting managers current, set up sign-in and repair directory connections.

## Agent server

- [Chrona MCP server](https://mcp.chrona365.com/): Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP at `https://mcp.chrona365.com/mcp`, no sign-in. Tools: `install_guide` (these pages by section or by question), `mapping_recipe` (a table's columns to the bindings and the calendar row), `generate_configuration` (the install and configuration as ordered Dataverse Web API requests, each naming the tool that sends it; for Chrona Workforce Scheduler also the staffing standards and install step 7, Turn on scheduled tasks). For Chrona Workforce Scheduler: `agreement_reading` (how your agent reads an agreement document and proposes its rules; the document stays with your agent), `generate_agreement` (one agreement's rules as ordered Dataverse Web API requests, and a template that links a person, which your agent fills), `import_mapping` (how a roster workbook maps, from the summary the import page saves, which holds no names), `board_link` (a link that opens the board on a roster period; nothing runs until the planner starts it). It writes nothing; your Dataverse tools do.

## Download

- [Releases](https://github.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/releases): `ChronaScheduler-<version>.zip` holds `01-ChronaScheduler_<version>_managed.zip` (the version with underscores) and the install guide.
- [Source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/konfigure8/chrona-scheduler/main/src/README.md): the control's source for the latest release and how to build it, under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.
